candidate_sentence_map.S1: WindowMaster International’s 2025 performance weakened compared with 2024, mainly because of a slow start to the year, lower sales to a major Nordic customer, reduced activity in Climatic in the Nordic region, and slower growth in North America.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Revenue declined 8% to DKK 268.6 million from DKK 294.5 million, below the original budget by DKK 21–41 million but in line with the latest guidance of DKK 269–270 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: Revenue improved during the second half of the year, which Management expects to continue into 2026.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Gross profit decreased to DKK 131.1 million from DKK 137.9 million, but the gross margin improved to 48.8% from 46.9%.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: The report links the margin improvement to a changed business mix, with less revenue from key accounts and more direct project revenue, consistent with the Accelerate Core strategy.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: The major customer generated DKK 30 million of revenue, down from DKK 43 million in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: EBITDA declined to DKK 28.0 million from DKK 37.3 million, reducing the EBITDA margin to 10.4% from 12.7%.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: Fixed costs were maintained to support future growth, while the result was also reduced by DKK 2.5 million of extraordinary costs following a ransomware attack in May and June.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: Earnings before tax fell to DKK 2.9 million from DKK 12.2 million, and profit after tax declined to DKK 0.9 million from DKK 10.6 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: The effective tax rate rose to 70% from 13%, partly because tax assets and tax-loss carryforwards were not utilized.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: Cash flow remained positive despite the lower earnings.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: Operating cash flow was DKK 28.5 million, compared with DKK 29.4 million in 2024, supported by improved net working capital, particularly inventories and work in progress.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: Investing cash outflow decreased to DKK 9.4 million from DKK 17.6 million, although investments continued in digitalization, software, process automation, and IT infrastructure and security.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: Year-end cash increased to DKK 4.0 million from DKK 3.4 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Net interest-bearing debt rose to DKK 38.7 million from DKK 36.7 million, and gearing increased to 1.7 from 1.2 but remained below the target of 2.0.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: Equity declined to DKK 32.5 million from DKK 36.6 million, with the net-cash equity ratio at 23.5%, below the target of 25%.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: Market activity improved in the second half as interest rates stabilized, particularly in non-residential construction.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: Demand continued to benefit from energy-efficiency investments and environmental regulation, although residential demand remained subdued and reduced supply-chain constraints lowered order visibility.
candidate_sentence_map.S19: For 2026, Management expects organic revenue growth of 7–14% to DKK 290–310 million and EBITDA of DKK 45–55 million, corresponding to an EBITDA margin of approximately 8–10%.

evaluation.label: Generally yes
evaluation.justification: K1, K2, K3, K4, K5, K6, K8, and K9 are all PRESENT with supporting trace sentences. K7 is MISSING entirely – no mention of North America market attractiveness, green technology, import tariffs, or WindowMaster’s competitive position. The overall coverage is strong, but the absence of K7 (a MEDIUM importance item) prevents a perfect score. Therefore, the summary captures most material information, but with a notable omission, resulting in a score of 3 (Generally yes).
